brief:
Israel's Shin Bet security agency confirmed that Benjamin Netanyahu's son Yair was flown back to Israel from the United States following a significant threat to his life, the Times of Israel reported. The agency provided no details about the nature of the threat, who made it, or the specific circumstances that prompted the decision to extract him from American soil.

Yair Netanyahu had been in the US at the time of the threat. The Shin Bet did not specify how long he had been there or where in the country he was located when the decision was made to return him to Israel. Officials offered no public comment on whether the threat remained active or had been neutralized.
dek: Shin Bet confirms Netanyahu's son brought back after 'significant threat' Israel’s Shin Bet security agency has confirmed that Benjamin Netanyahu’s son, Yair, was flown back to Israel from the US after a threat to his life, according to the Times of Israel.…
title: Shin Bet confirms Netanyahu's son flown back from US over threat
